name: ETERNAL Project
source:
A town of grays. A town rotting as humanity declines. To keep this the town afloat, the Church has created a rapidly spreading new religion, the Guiding Light. A religion that brings people to their own false unified happiness.

Mario Chou, is under the impression this is a conspiracy. A conspiracy that has the entire town in chains. Basing his delusions under his favorite anime, Magical Girl Risu, he vows to gather a team of girls to defeat the Church. He’ll search far and wide to create a magical girl team!

Maika Sussmey. A runaway from the “Correction Facility.” She plans on dominating this town for herself.

Elise Cadence. An occult maniac high school girl.

May Wong. Mario’s stalker and little sister of his brainwashed childhood friend.

And Eternal. The God of the town. A God who’s sick of being God, who entrusts Mario Chou to bring about the last in entertainment.

[From [url=http://eternalproject.tumblr.com/story]Official site[/url]]
translation:
一座灰色的小镇。随着人类衰落，小镇也逐渐腐烂。为了让小镇维持下去，教会创立了迅速传播的新宗教“引导之光”。这是一种把人们带向虚假统一幸福的宗教。

马里奥·周认为这一切是阴谋，是让整座小镇陷入枷锁的阴谋。他以自己最喜欢的动画《魔法少女莉丝》为妄想依据，发誓召集一群女孩击败教会。他将走遍各地，组建魔法少女队伍！

麦卡·萨斯梅伊。从“矫正设施”逃出的少女，计划独自支配这座小镇。

伊莉丝·凯登斯。沉迷神秘学的高中女生。

梅·王。马里奥的跟踪者，也是他那位被洗脑的青梅竹马的妹妹。

还有永恒。小镇之神。一位厌倦成为神明、把最后的娱乐托付给马里奥·周的神。

[来源：[url=http://eternalproject.tumblr.com/story]官方网站[/url]]
